page_title: PAR 1-0 JUV | Parma v Juventus 23/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) gets inside the box and tries to beat Zion Suzuki with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.

90+1' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) takes the corner which is cleared.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Timothy Weah (Juventus) will replace Nicolas Gonzalez.
86' The manager makes a subsitution with Alberto Costa (Juventus) coming on for Lloyd Kelly.
86' Igor Tudor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Douglas Luiz (Juventus) replacing Manuel Locatelli.
86' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ange-Yoan Bonny will be replaced by Pontus Almqvist (Parma).
83' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
81' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
80' The corner from Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is intercepted by Zion Suzuki.

79' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
76' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
76' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
75' It will be a substitution. Dennis Man (Parma) is ready to enter the pitch as Mateo Pellegrino walks off.
74' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
73' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Juventus will have an opportunity.
71' The corner from Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is hurriedly cleared.
69' Daniele Chiffi shows the yellow card to Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) for a heavy challenge.
66' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

65' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Zion Suzuki tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
64' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

63' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Juventus. Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
61' Giovanni Leoni (Parma) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
60' Simon Sohm (Parma) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Michele Di Gregorio makes a great save.
58' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Weston McKennie trots off the pitch and is replaced by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).
56' An attempted cross from Weston McKennie (Juventus) is cleared.
53' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
50' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Zion Suzuki intercepts the ball.
49' Yellow card. Hernani (Parma) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
47' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is replaced by Francisco Conceicao.
46' Half-time substitution. Nahuel Estevez (Parma) is replaced by Hernani.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' The resulting corner, taken by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus), comes to nothing.
45+4' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag and Juventus will take a corner.

45+1' 1 - 0 Emanuele Valeri produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) rises high to head the ball into the top right corner and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:0.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
44' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
43' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
42' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
39' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
38' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
37' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

36' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The referee signals a corner kick to Juventus.
35' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Zion Suzuki, who smothers the ball.
33' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Simon Sohm (Parma).
30' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Nahuel Estevez (Parma). Daniele Chiffi saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
28' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
28' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Parma are awarded a corner kick.
25' What was Simon Sohm (Parma) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
24' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
23' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Antoine Hainaut (Parma). It will be a corner kick for Parma.
22' Daniele Chiffi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Lloyd Kelly (Juventus).
21' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Parma.
20' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
19' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
19' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
15' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) is penalised for holding. Daniele Chiffi signals a set piece.
14' Parma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

14' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way. The ball is out of play. Parma will have a chance to score from a corner.
13' Dangerous play by Weston McKennie (Juventus). Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Problems for Christian Chivu as Alessandro Vogliacco (Parma) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Antoine Hainaut replaces him.
10' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) is substituted due to injury. Christian Chivu gives a chance to Nahuel Estevez.
9' Weston McKennie (Juventus) serves up a nice cross, but Zion Suzuki punches the ball away.
9' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
8' Alessandro Vogliacco (Parma) picks up an injury.
7' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Juventus will have a corner.
3' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle. Weston McKennie (Juventus) commits a foul after dangerous play.

1' The ball spins to Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Juventus will take the kick-off.
